summary: Completed backend and frontend regression testing for health, admin auth, protected routing, and requested dashboard routes.

integration_issues.flow: Initial app settings load on login/dashboard
integration_issues.issue: AppSettingsProvider first requests /api/settings without authentication, producing 401 responses and browser console errors before falling back to /api/settings/public. This does not block rendering or login but violates the no-network-failures expectation.

action_items: Avoid calling authenticated /api/settings before auth state is known, or suppress expected 401 fallback noise by using /api/settings/public for unauthenticated screens.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; existing seeded admin account used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health/root, admin cookie login and /api/auth/me, unauthenticated redirect, login form, and /dashboard plus employees/attendance/tasks/reports/settings/dispatch all passed. Recheck settings request console noise after any AppSettingsProvider change.
rca of the issue: AppSettingsProvider.refresh() always tries GET /settings first, while that endpoint requires get_current_user; on pre-auth load it returns 401 and then fallback GET /settings/public succeeds. The fallback is functional, but the rejected request is surfaced in browser console.
